• 3 days
• minimum food & water supply per person
• 3 L
• drinking water per person per day
• 1 wk
• supplies recommended for major earthquakes
• Also pack: flashlight, portable radio, mobile battery, cash, copies of your residence card and passport, and any daily medication

Q1. Who must enroll in National Health Insurance?
Everyone registered as a resident of Hikari City with a stay of more than 3 months must have public health insurance. If you are not covered by your employer's health insurance (Shakai Hoken), you must enroll in National Health Insurance (Kokumin Kenko Hoken). Enrollment procedures must be completed within 14 days of moving in or leaving employer insurance.
